known_risks: A root vitest.config.js now exists where none did before. It sets globalSetup and nothing else, deliberately, so stock discovery behaviour is preserved -- evidenced by the count staying at exactly 535 tests / 51 files. Any future edit to this file must re-check that count, because a changed include glob would silently drop tests while still reporting green.

The setup DELIBERATELY DOES NOT ISOLATE when a paths.config.json already exists: it logs and leaves the file alone. A developer pointing the panel at a real data root would therefore still see the suite write to that root. This is the intended trade -- silently clobbering a real override would be far worse than the defect being fixed -- but it means isolation is conditional, not absolute.

Isolation depends on globalSetup running before workers import server/database/init.js. That ordering holds because getDataPaths() memoizes at first import and globalSetup runs in the main process before workers spawn. A future move of this logic to setupFiles would be too late and would silently stop working -- the symptom would be the return of data/db.json, not a test failure.
